brief: A jug with a lid to mix my baby's formula milk in and keep it in the fridge.

requirements.requirement: A jug-shaped container to mix formula in
requirements.evidence: Built a tall hex vessel: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full with bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full (full-depth hex bin, ~160mm tall inner). It is a hexagonal open container, not a round jug with a spout or handle (no handle socket was offered even after the lid was fitted), so pouring/mixing shape is only approximated.
cover:0,0,1;full;top fitted as a solid top cover over the bin cell, closing the vessel. House rules applied: capOpenFaces and lockJoints. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Safe to hold baby's formula milk (food safety)
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks fit only and knows nothing about materials, food safety, waterproofing or dishwasher/sterilisation safety. The parts are 3D-printed in a material the user chooses; layered prints are not verified watertight or food-safe, so this build must not be used to mix or store infant formula. A food-safe, sterilisable commercial jug/bottle is needed for that.

requirements.requirement: Keep it in the fridge (sealed, cold storage of formula)
requirements.evidence: No seal/gasket is modelled and leak-tightness, food safety and safe refrigerated storage of infant formula cannot be verified by this configurator; as above, do not store formula in this printed vessel.

finish.summary: Built a tall, lidded hexagonal container (two stacked full cells, full-depth bin, solid top cover, caps and locked joints; 220x169x218mm, check_build clear) as the closest jug-with-lid shape the system offers — but with an explicit warning: this is a 3D-printed shape model only. It is not verified watertight, food-safe or sterilisable, has no spout/seal, and must NOT be used to mix or refrigerate baby formula. Please use a commercial food-safe, sterilisable formula jug/bottle for feeding; this build can serve only as a dry-goods / non-food stand-in or size mock-up.
